{"overview": "Click analytics as an additive click package: RedirectController offers each successful redirect to a ClickRecorder, which writes it in the background; a statistics endpoint reads aggregated counts. The redirect cache stores the expiry and re-checks it on every hit.", "components": [{"name": "ClickRecorder", "responsibility": "Non-blocking click capture and batched writes", "files": ["src/main/java/io/github/marishasahay/shortener/click/ClickRecorder.java"]}, {"name": "LinkStatsService", "responsibility": "Totals and zero-filled daily counts", "files": ["src/main/java/io/github/marishasahay/shortener/click/LinkStatsService.java"]}, {"name": "ClickRepository", "responsibility": "Batch insert, aggregates, purge", "files": ["src/main/java/io/github/marishasahay/shortener/click/ClickRepository.java"]}], "openApiYaml": "openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: URL Shortener API
  version: 1.1.0
  description: |
    Creates short links and redirects short codes to their target URLs.

    All errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`). `type` is omitted
    when it is `about:blank`; `instance` is the request path. Operational endpoints
    (`/actuator/health`, `/actuator/info`, `/actuator/metrics`) are not part of this contract.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080

paths:
  /api/v1/links:
    post:
      operationId: createLink
      summary: Create a short link
      description: |
        Creates a link with a random 7-character base62 code, or with `customAlias` as the code.
        Rate limited per client IP (default 20 requests per minute, token bucket).
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
            examples:
              generated:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/some/long/path
              customAliasWithExpiry:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/launch
                  customAlias: launch-2026
                  expiresAt: '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Link created.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: Absolute URL of the link's metadata resource (`{baseUrl}/api/v1/links/{code}`).
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/AliasConflict'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLink
      summary: Get link metadata
      description: Returns the link, including expired links. Deleted links are not found.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The link.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'
    delete:
      operationId: deleteLink
      summary: Delete a link
      description: |
        Soft-deletes the link and evicts it from the redirect cache. The code is never reused:
        creating a link with the same alias afterwards returns 409.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Link deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}/stats:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLinkStats
      summary: Get click statistics
      description: |
        Clicks of an active (not deleted) link, including expired links. Recording is best
        effort and asynchronous: statistics lag redirects by about the flush interval (1 s by
        default), and clicks are dropped (and counted in the `shortener.clicks.dropped` metric)
        if the in-memory buffer is full or the process stops abruptly. Totals cover the
        retention period (90 days by default). No IP addresses or user-agent strings are stored.
      parameters:
        - name: days
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Number of UTC days in `daily`, including today (1 to the retention period).
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 90
            default: 7
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The statistics.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkStats'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: |
          The short code. Paths that do not match the pattern are not routed to this operation
          and return 404.
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
    get:
      operationId: redirect
      summary: Redirect to the target URL
      description: |
        Responds with `302 Found` (not 301) and `Cache-Control: no-store`, so browsers do not
        cache the redirect and every visit reaches the service. Expiry is enforced on every
        request, including when the link is cached. Each redirect is offered to the click
        recorder (best effort, see `getLinkStats`); 404 and 410 responses are not counted.
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to the target URL.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The target URL.
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              description: Always `no-store`.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '410':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Gone'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

components:
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required: [url]
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          maxLength: 2048
          description: |
            Absolute `http` or `https` URL with a host. Rejected (400) if it contains user info
            (e.g. `https://bank.com@evil.com`), points at the shortener's own host, or is longer
            than 2048 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        customAlias:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          description: |
            Optional code to use instead of a generated one. Reserved words (case-insensitive):
            api, actuator, health, admin, static, assets, public, login, logout, error, favicon,
            robots, metrics, info, docs, swagger, openapi, www.
          examples: [launch-2026]
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Optional ISO-8601 instant; must be in the future. Stored at microsecond precision.
          examples: ['2026-12-31T23:59:59Z']

    LinkResponse:
      type: object
      required: [code, shortUrl, targetUrl, createdAt, expiresAt]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          examples: [aZ3kP9q]
        shortUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: '`{baseUrl}/{code}`'
          examples: ['http://localhost:8080/aZ3kP9q']
        targetUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          examples: ['2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
        expiresAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: '`null` when the link never expires.'
          examples: [null]

    LinkStats:
      type: object
      required: [code, totalClicks, lastClickAt, from, to, daily]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          examples: [launch-2026]
        totalClicks:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Clicks recorded within the retention period.
          examples: [42]
        lastClickAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: '`null` when no click has been recorded.'
          examples: ['2026-01-07T09:30:00Z']
        from:
          type: string
          format: date
          description: First UTC day of `daily`.
          examples: ['2026-01-01']
        to:
          type: string
          format: date
          description: Last UTC day of `daily` (today).
          examples: ['2026-01-07']
        daily:
          type: array
          description: One entry per UTC day from `from` to `to`, oldest first; days without clicks have 0.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyClicks'

    DailyClicks:
      type: object
      required: [date, clicks]
      properties:
        date:
          type: string
          format: date
          examples: ['2026-01-07']
        clicks:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          examples: [5]

    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem document.
      required: [title, status, instance]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: Omitted when `about:blank`.
        title:
          type: string
          description: |
            Short summary. Application errors use: `Invalid request`, `Link not found`,
            `Link expired`, `Alias already in use`, `Too many requests`,
            `Short code generation failed`, `Internal server error`. Framework errors (e.g.
            malformed JSON, unsupported media type) use the HTTP reason phrase.
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: The request path.
        errors:
          type: array
          description: Present on `Invalid request` (400) problems.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/FieldViolation'

    FieldViolation:
      type: object
      required: [field, message]
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          examples: [url]
        message:
          type: string
          examples: [must not be blank]

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: |
        Invalid request: bean validation failure (missing `url`), target URL or alias policy
        violation, expiry not in the future, a statistics window (`days`) out of range, or
        malformed / unparseable JSON.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          examples:
            validation:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: Request validation failed
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not be blank
            policy:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: url must not contain user info
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not contain user info
            malformedJson:
              value:
                title: Bad Request
                status: 400
                detail: Failed to read request
                instance: /api/v1/links
    NotFound:
      description: No active link exists for the code (never created, or deleted).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link not found
            status: 404
            detail: No link exists for code 'aZ3kP9q'
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    Gone:
      description: The link exists but has expired.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link expired
            status: 410
            detail: The link for code 'aZ3kP9q' has expired
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    AliasConflict:
      description: The custom alias is already in use (including by a deleted link).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Alias already in use
            status: 409
            detail: The alias 'launch-2026' is already in use
            instance: /api/v1/links
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: The request body is not `application/json`.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    TooManyRequests:
      description: The client exceeded the link-creation rate limit.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          description: Seconds until the next request will be accepted (at least 1).
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Too many requests
            status: 429
            detail: Rate limit exceeded; retry after 3 seconds
            instance: /api/v1/links
    InternalServerError:
      description: |
        Unexpected failure, or no unique code could be generated within 5 attempts
        (`Short code generation failed`).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
", "dataModel": "link_clicks(id, code, clicked_at timestamptz, referrer_host varchar(255), agent_family varchar(16) check in BROWSER/BOT/OTHER); indexes (code, clicked_at) and (clicked_at).", "decisions": [{"title": "Where clicks are recorded", "choice": "After a successful resolve in RedirectController", "rationale": "404/410 are not clicks; the controller already has the headers", "alternatives": ["Servlet filter (sees failed lookups too)"]}, {"title": "Click key", "choice": "Store the code, not the link id", "rationale": "Codes are never reused; recording needs no extra lookup", "alternatives": ["link_id foreign key"]}, {"title": "Privacy", "choice": "Referrer host and agent family only", "rationale": "Enough for campaign analysis; no personal data", "alternatives": ["Hashed IP"]}, {"title": "Issue #1", "choice": "Cache (target, expiresAt) and re-check expiry on every lookup", "rationale": "Correct at the exact instant with no database access on hits", "alternatives": ["Shorter TTL"]}], "risks": ["Best-effort counts can under-count during saturation or crashes"]}
